reviews.shade: ilso Super Melting Sebum Softener 150ml Set (+Cotton Pad 40P+Pore Tension Mask Sheet 1ea)
reviews.text: I have oily skin with blackheads and visible pores, so I’m always looking for products that help with sebum control without drying out my skin. I recently started using the Ilso Super Melting Sebum Softener, and I’m honestly so impressed already. The bottle is big and the design is very convenient — it feels clean and hygienic when applying. The liquid has a light, refreshing texture that feels really pleasant on the skin, almost like water, and it absorbs quickly without any stickiness. After using it regularly, my T-zone feels less oily during the day, and the pores around my nose look cleaner and a bit tighter. I also noticed that blackheads are easier to remove when I use this before extraction or a clay mask. It doesn’t irritate my sensitive areas at all, and the formula feels calming thanks to the Centella extract. I love how balanced my skin feels — not dry, not greasy, just smooth and comfortable. I’m excited to keep using it to see even better results!
reviews.zh: 我皮膚油性，有黑頭同明顯毛孔，所以我一直都喺搵能夠控制皮脂、又唔會令皮膚乾燥嘅產品。我最近開始用 Ilso Super Melting Sebum Softener，真係已經好欣賞佢。個樽好大，設計好方便——塗嘅時候感覺乾淨衛生。質地清爽輕盈，搽喺皮膚上好舒服，幾乎似清水咁，而且吸收好快，冇黏膩感。定期使用之後，我嘅T字位白天冇咁油，鼻邊嘅毛孔睇落更乾淨，又收緊咗少少。我亦留意到，喺做清潔（導出）或者用泥膜之前用呢款，黑頭就更易清走。佢完全唔會刺激我嘅敏感位，而且因為含有積雪草萃取物，配方令人覺得舒緩。我好鍾意皮膚感覺平衡嘅狀態——唔乾，唔油，只係滑溜舒服。我好期待繼續用，睇吓會有幾好嘅效果！
